data.description: When an asteroid is full destroyed there is a 5% (configurable) chance that it will drop an extra life power up. It will not drop any other power ups or weapons. It will continue to drop minerals.
data.title: Asteroids drop more lives

data.description: Make the sound of the side thrusters 50% quieter than the forward and make them a semi tone higher pitched.
data.title: Side thrusters should be quietr and higher pitched

data.author: Map
data.comment:
Intake interview — OPEN QUESTIONS (answers pending):

**Q1 — When does the 5% extra-life roll fire?** 'when an asteroid is fully destroyed' — does that mean only the terminal **small** tier (large/medium merely split and roll nothing), or any asteroid kill (large/medium/small all roll)?

**Q2 — Relationship with the generic drop pool:** asteroids must not drop other power-ups/weapons — should the 5% extra-life roll **replace** the generic per-kill roll for asteroids (asteroids are removed from the 18% weighted pool entirely), and the 5% be their only power-up drop? Minerals unchanged.

**Q3 — Where is the 5% configured?** a  field (e.g. asteroidExtraLifeDropChance, default 0.05, localStorage-persisted via rules.ts like other tunables + schema bump), vs a plain module constant; and should the behaviour be exercised by a gym (e.g. GymMinerals asteroids-only field) via a shared helper in src/scenes/core/?
